instruction.text: Kayla just read a text about Scotland. She is sharing some facts with her classmate Miles. Decide how Miles reacts.

atoms.b: Did you know? Scotland is just as far north as Alaska!
atoms.sound: ssml: Did you know? <break time='300ms' /> Scotland is just as far north as Alaska!

atoms.b: Yeah, and here’s an even more incredible fact: Scotland’s national animal is a unicorn!
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />Yeah, and here’s an even more incredible fact: <break time='300ms' />Scotland’s national animal is a unicorn!

atoms.b: ((++No_way! ++That’s_crazy!)) There is no chance that’s true!
I’m telling you, it’s all true! It says so in the text I just read.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />I’m telling you, it’s all true! It says so in the text I just read.<break time='1000ms' />

instruction.text: Miles finds it difficult to believe Kayla’s claims. Find Scotland on the map to hear what a claim is.

end.text: A claim is a statement that something is the truth or a fact. It usually needs some kind of support to prove it is true.

instruction.text: Miles continues the conversation. Now decide how Kayla reacts.

atoms.b: Hold up, Kayla. Does the author of this text you read give any kind of support to what it claims?
atoms.sound: Hold up Kayla. Does the author of this text you red give any kind of support to what it claims?

atoms.b: ((++Huh? ++What?)) I don’t understand what you mean by 'support'.
In order for the text to be more believable, it should have some sort of evidence or reason to support the claims.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />In order for the text to be more believable, it should have some sort of evidence or reason to support the claims.

atoms.b: ((++Right. ++Ok.)) Now I understand. Well, let me take a look.

instruction.text: Find and select the unicorn’s horn on the image to hear what support Kayla finds for the claims in the text.
Listen to and correctly complete the rest of their conversation.

atoms.b: Well, it says here that geographically, Alaska and Scotland are approximately on the same degrees of latitude.
That means they are both about the same distance away from the equator. That’s ((++evidence))!
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />That means they are both about the same distance away from the equator. That’s evidence!

atoms.b: And then the author writes, that because Scotland is a country with many myths and legends, the unicorn was made their national animal.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />And then the author writes, that because Scotland is a country with many myths and legends, the unicorn was made their national animal.

atoms.b: And that would be a ((++reason)). It seems you were telling the truth after all.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms' />And that would be a reason. It seems you were telling the truth after all.
ssml: <break time='500ms' />Of course I was!<break time='1000ms' />
